'''Nalyd''' was an [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] and the homeworld of the [[Nalydian]]s, a species of [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]], stocky [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoids]]. Its inhabitants practiced the [[Death/Legends|death penalty]] on citizens who had broken the law, and it was there that [[Ania Solo]] and [[Jao Assam]] went in search of [[Darth Wredd]]'s minion, [[Dieben]], in [[138 ABY]].

==Description==
===Geography===
[[File:NalydPillars.jpg|left|thumb|180px|View of Nalyd's environment]]
Nalyd was a terrestrial [[Planet/Legends|planet]] with an [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]] suitable for most [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] species, including [[Human/Legends|Humans]]. From orbit, the world appeared as a uniform brown sphere, devoid of any distinguishing features such as visible landforms or bodies of [[Water/Legends|water]]. From the planet’s ground, the sky appeared to be suffused with a bright orange glow, while a thick mist limited visibility.<ref name="L7" />

The surface of Nalyd was dominated by colossal rock pillars, densely grouped together. The planet’s ecosystem seemed sparse, consisting mainly of [[Nalydian floating jellyfish|jellyfish-like creatures]] that drifted in large numbers among the columns, and hairy [[Nalydian giant spider|six-legged beings]] adept at climbing up and down their immense heights. At the base of the rock pillars, liquid collected to form vast but desolate wetlands that glowed with a vivid green light, notable only for patches of stunted vegetation resembling clusters of sharp stakes.<ref name="L7" />

===People===
{{Quote|This planet is not quite as cosmopolitan as I had hoped.|Jao Assam, an Imperial Knight who visited the planet|<ref name="L7" />}}
[[File:NalydArena.jpg|right|thumb|280px|Arena of the Nalydians]]
Nalyd was homeworld of the [[Nalydian]]s, a species of [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]], stocky [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoids]]. This grim people built structures atop the stone pillars for their own purposes, hollowing out massive arenas within them. In navigating the complex landscape of their homeland, including reaching the peaks of the pillars, they relied on six-legged creatures that were harnessed for transport. The Nalydians abided by laws and could sentence serious offenders to public execution.<ref name="L7" />

==History==
{{Quote|His name is Dieben. He had a criminal record on his home planet, so he was extradited back there... to Nalyd!|Jao Assam, to Ania Solo|<ref name="L7" />}}
[[File:NalydPort.jpg|left|thumb|280px|The common port of Nalyd]]
Nalyd was a planet situated in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]], within the [[Tharin sector/Legends|Tharin sector]],<ref name="EAOC" /> close to the border of the [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]]. The territorial affiliation of the region changed constantly, and various galactic conflicts did not pass the sector by.<ref name="EA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref>

[[File:NalydArenaOutside.jpg|right|thumb|280px|The arena where Dieben was to be executed]]
By the end of the rule of [[Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire|Darth Krayt's Sith Empire]], Nalyd was not widely known and was regarded as a non-cosmopolitan world, where the population largely consisted of native inhabitants. Nevertheless, the Nalydians were not isolated; they maintained contact with the outside galaxy and even preferred to communicate in [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Basic]]. Around the same time, a dangerous [[Terrorist/Legends|terrorist]] named [[Dieben]] was active on the planet. He committed numerous atrocities, including the assassination of a minister, assault on a law enforcement officer, and the sabotage of public transportation that resulted in ten deaths. Many Nalydians wished for Dieben’s death, but he escaped justice and vanished among the [[Star/Legends|stars]], far from his homeworld.<ref name="L7" />

[[File:NalydWetland.jpg|left|thumb|280px|Ania Solo and Jao Assam stand near Dieben's corpse]]
Eventually, Dieben was apprehended in the [[Surd Nebula/Legends|Surd Nebula]] by local security forces. He was quickly identified as a wanted fugitive and extradited to Nalyd, where he would face justice for his past crimes. Shortly before the trial, [[Imperial Knight]] [[Jao Assam]] and the [[junk dealer/Legends|junk dealer]] [[Ania Solo]] arrived on Nalyd, following their only lead to [[Darth Wredd]] – Dieben, who had once been in Wredd’s employ. Seeking to question him about Wredd’s whereabouts, Jao and Ania [[Skirmish on Nalyd|abducted]] Dieben from the arena where he was scheduled to be executed. During the escape attempt, however, Dieben was killed without disclosing any information about Wredd.<ref name="L7" /> The Nalydian authorities later informed Jao and Ania that Dieben had influential associates in the [[Mon Calamari system/Legends|Calamari system]], prompting the pair to travel to [[Dac/Legends|Dac]].<ref name="L8" />

==Behind the scenes==
The planet Nalyd first appeared in the [[Legacy (2013) 7|seventh issue]] of the ''[[Star Wars: Legacy Volume 2]]'' comic series. The cover tagline proclaimed «Descent into Danger!», depicting Nalyd as a bleak and treacherous world. However, in the actual storyline the planet turned out to be rather ordinary, bearing little resemblance to the perilous setting suggested by the misleading cover.
